src: ui.font_point_size: application font size in points. Applied immediately; "Follow the system" stores no value at all.
tr: ui.font_point_size：应用字体大小（磅）。立即生效；选择「跟随系统」时不保存任何值。

src: ui.scale_percent: interface zoom. Qt reads QT_SCALE_FACTOR once, when the application is constructed, so this takes effect on the next start.
tr: ui.scale_percent：界面缩放。Qt 只在应用构造时读取一次 QT_SCALE_FACTOR，因此下次启动才生效。

src: The font applies to the whole interface immediately. The editor's own font is a KTextEditor setting and belongs to the editor lane.
tr: 字体立即作用于整个界面。编辑器自身的字体是 KTextEditor 的设置，属于编辑器 lane。

src: The options of the selected lint engine (Tools → Lint engine). The page shows one set of controls; both engines keep their own settings, so switching the engine never loses the other one.
tr: 所选 Lint 引擎的选项（工具 → Lint 引擎）。本页只有一套控件；两个引擎各自保存自己的设置，切换引擎不会丢失另一套。
空：使用 verible 内置规则集

src: empty: no waiver files (one path per line)
tr: 空：不使用豁免文件（每行一个路径）

src: empty: slang's own selection (one -W value per line, e.g. everything)
tr: 空：使用 slang 自身的选择（每行一个 -W 值，例如 everything）
空：使用 slang 自身的上限

src: Options for verible-verilog-format. An empty value means "use the formatter's own default": no flag is passed at all, so an untouched page formats exactly as before.
tr: verible-verilog-format 的选项。留空表示「使用格式化器自身的默认值」：完全不传标志，未改动的页面与以前完全一致。

src: Clears every format option, so the formatter's own defaults apply and no flag is passed.
tr: 清空所有格式化选项，改用格式化器自身的默认值，不传任何标志。

src: Scale 100 %: no QT_SCALE_FACTOR override is set.
Scale %1 %: the next start sets QT_SCALE_FACTOR=%2 — restart VEdit to apply it.
tr: 缩放 %1%：下次启动将设置 QT_SCALE_FACTOR=%2 —— 重启 VEdit 生效。

src: %1 is sent to the selected lint job.
tr: 会向所选 Lint 任务发送 %1。

src: Active engine. --rules_config is applied; the other options are stored but not sent yet (transport pending).
tr: 当前引擎。--rules_config 已生效；其余选项已保存但尚未发送（传输待实现）。

src: Not the selected engine — these controls are disabled. Switch Tools → Lint engine to verible-verilog-lint to edit them; their values are kept.
tr: 不是当前引擎——这些控件已禁用。切换到 工具 → Lint 引擎 → verible-verilog-lint 即可编辑；它们的值会保留。

src: Active engine. -W and --error-limit are stored but not sent yet (transport pending).
tr: 当前引擎。-W 与 --error-limit 已保存但尚未发送（传输待实现）。

src: Not the selected engine — these controls are disabled. Switch Tools → Lint engine to slang to edit them; their values are kept.
tr: 不是当前引擎——这些控件已禁用。切换到 工具 → Lint 引擎 → slang 即可编辑；它们的值会保留。

src: Every option of the selected engine is applied to the lint job.
tr: 所选引擎的全部选项都会应用到 Lint 任务。

src: Stored but not applied yet (the lint job's C ABI does not carry them): %1. They stay in settings.toml and will be sent once the ABI is extended.
tr: 已保存但尚未应用（Lint 任务的 C ABI 还不承载它们）：%1。它们保留在 settings.toml 中，待 ABI 扩展后发送。

src: Format options restored to verible's defaults (no flags are passed).
tr: 格式化选项已恢复为 verible 默认值（不传任何标志）。
